item.title: HAVING Clause in PostgreSQL: Filtering Aggregated Data
item.description:
The HAVING clause in PostgreSQL is a powerful tool for filtering aggregated data in the result set of a query. This clause enables developers to specify conditions for grouped results, allowing for more complex and targeted analysis. This article explores how to use the HAVING clause effectively in PostgreSQL.
